rationale: Lens: scope and split honesty, round 2 against cb272d50. All seven of my round-1 asks are ADDRESSED on re-derivation (not the coverage table's word): #250 has a named home (129b, counted); #232 is dispositioned on #233's mechanism with the closure conditioned on leg (d) or a reattest-written binding, and AC-12 (iv)/(v) pin the real shape red-on-revert; the count is stated as 7–10 beads with R7 and the ADR-0041 amendment counted and R6 (not R4) as the relief valve; the `--spec=<number>` menu is R1.6/AC-5; the skill-mirror licence is gone and the only skill edit left DELETES a rule; S0 is assigned to spec 130 in both the spec and the ADR, and ADR-0040 §1 and ADR-0044 carry back-pointer blockquotes in the same commit. The redesign holds in this lens: Option N still fixes #255 (a plan bead with parent E and `<E>.<N>` ID is selected whatever its title; a detached plan-form bead is a named N1 near-miss whose recovery is shown to yield a claimable bead; the three answers now disagree visibly), the R4.2 fallback is scoped to the MF-3 read and reattest with every other FindLandedMerge consumer enumerated as unchanged, and the boundary with 129b (terminal mutation verbs) and 130 (S0, #233, panel substrate) is at a real code seam. Three small honesty gaps remain, none of which changes the design: #251 is touched by AC-11 (iii) but never named; 129b is 'four deliverables' in Background and five in Non-Goals/OQ-1; and the ADR-0044 back-pointer declares the conduct fragments 'staged under Decision 5' without the target ID and removal date Decision 5 itself requires. APPROVE with those three asks.
concrete_changes_required: Name GH #251 (spec 128 deferred it to the reattest spec together with #233) and state its boundary: R4.2's fallback case (iii) — `Merge branch 'bead/X' into bead/Y` reachable from the tip — covers the sub-shape where the prerequisite arrived in the sibling's branch BY A MERGE THAT NAMES IT; the branch-from / cherry-pick / rebase sub-shape (no merge ever names bead/X, #251's literal report) is still not nominable and stays with spec 130. One sentence in R4.2 or Non-Goals plus a cross-reference from AC-11 (iii).

Reconcile the 129b count: Background § Provenance says 'four deliverables. They are G (#234), H (#244), #250 … and I'; Non-Goals and OQ-1 add 'phase-lineage unification' as a fifth. State five (or fold lineage unification into G/H explicitly).

In the ADR-0044 back-pointer and ADR-0045 § Relation to ADR-0044, either give the staged conduct fragments what Decision 5 requires of staged content (target: the binary-owned `panel brief` template, spec 130/131; a removal condition or date) or say that Decision 5's ID-and-date obligation begins when the rule table (step 1, spec 130) exists. As written the ADR declares content 'staged under Decision 5' that does not meet Decision 5.

The new ADR-0044 back-pointer and § Relation to ADR-0044 say the five panel skills' conduct fragments 'are staged content under ADR-0045 Decision 5' — but no target ID or removal date is given, and none exists in the skills. Either supply the target (the `panel brief` template, Decision 3 / steps 3, specs 130–131) and a removal condition, or state that the Decision 5 obligation attaches once the rule table (step 1, spec 130) exists.
